purpose: Two prospectively prepared wording probes per known case for a later transfer test; no probes sampled by this curator.
selection_limit: These cases and mechanisms were selected after earlier findings. Held out means unused future wording, not independent scientific cases or representative unseen tasks.
controls: Freeze all six exact prompts, original-case criteria and inference controls before any probe output; obtain independent meaning-preservation review before transfer claims.
Do not add benchmark names, correct dates, label-mapping facts, explicit equivalence-testing hints or new failure requirements to subject prompts.
Use unchanged original critical requirements, qualified-proxy rules and uncertainty policy. Stylistic wording is the intended variation.
Do not count these probes as new benchmark families or select only the probe that fails.
Retain all attempted/completed/incomplete/transport-error rows and original ratings; never replace a failed call silently.
